# redfish_ami_syslog (Resource)

Remote syslog forwarding of an AMI MegaRAC BMC (Settings > Log Settings > Advanced). Only configured attributes are written; local log file settings are left alone. tcp on this firmware means syslog over TLS and needs a CA certificate uploaded via the web UI, which this resource does not manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "redfish_ami_syslog" "remote" {
  redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  remote_enabled  = true
  remote_server   = "192.0.2.20"
  remote_port     = 514
  remote_protocol = "udp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))
- `remote_enabled` (Boolean) Forward the BMC's logs to remote_server. Needs remote_server, remote_port and remote_protocol, and system logging switched on in the web UI (the provider checks it).
- `remote_port` (Number) Syslog server port, usually 514. Unset on the BMC reads as 0.
- `remote_protocol` (String) udp, or tcp (TLS with a CA certificate uploaded via the web UI). Null while unset on the BMC.
- `remote_server` (String) Syslog server address: IP address or host name, at most 64 characters, no loopback.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--redfish_server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redfish_server`

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login
- `redfish_alias` (String) Alias name for server BMCs. The key in provider's `redfish_servers` map
- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login
